name: Binvox File Parsing
definition: Parses the binvox binary voxel format, reading a fixed header (version, dimensions) and run-length encoded voxel data into a contiguous unsigned char array.
summary: Binvox file parsing reads binary voxel files by interpreting ASCII headers and decompressing RLE data into voxel grids or octrees, distinguished by its specific handling of this unique format.
